groups.title: Human Resources Managers

groups.title: Policy and Planning Managers

groups.title: Research and Development Managers

groups.inclusionExclusion: Advertising Specialists and Marketing Professionals are excluded from this unit group. Advertising Specialists are included in Occupation 221131 Advertising Specialist. Marketing Professionals are included in Unit Group 2215 Marketing Professionals.

groups.title: Communications Managers (Public Relations)

groups.title: ICT Managers

groups.inclusionExclusion: Chief Information Officers and Chief Information Security Officers are excluded from this sub-major group. Chief Information Officers are included in Occupation 113131 Chief Information Officer. Chief Information Security Officers are included in Occupation 113132 Chief Information Security Officer.

groups.title: Chief Executives, General Managers and Legislators
groups.leadStatement: Plan, organise, direct, control and review the overall operations of organisations and their major programs, and represent constituencies in parliaments and local government authorities.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Chief Information Officers and Chief Information Security Officers are excluded from this minor group. Chief Information Officers are included in Occupation 113131 Chief Information Officer. Chief Information Security Officers are included in Occupation 113132 Chief Information Security Officer.

groups.title: Chief Executives and Managing Directors

groups.inclusionExclusion: Chief Information Officers and Chief Information Security Officers are excluded from this unit group. Chief Information Officers are included in Occupation 113131 Chief Information Officer. Chief Information Security Officers are included in Occupation 113132 Chief Information Security Officer.

groups.title: Legislators

groups.title: Construction, Production and Distribution Managers

groups.title: Importers, Exporters and Wholesalers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the operations of importing, exporting and wholesaling trading establishments.

groups.title: Procurement Managers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the procurement and purchasing of materials, products and services for organisations.

groups.title: Supply and Distribution Managers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the supply, storage and distribution of goods produced by organisations.

groups.title: Education, Health, Welfare and Other Specialist Managers

groups.title: Other Specialist Managers
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Specialist Managers not elsewhere classified. It includes Airport Managers, Correctional Facility Managers and Emergency Management Officers.

groups.title: Real Estate Agency Principals

groups.leadStatement: Organise and control the operations of organisations and establishments providing services such as call centre and customer contact services, event and facilities management, hair and beauty services, and transport services.

groups.title: Digital Designers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, design and develop user interfaces and user experiences, websites and other digital content for a range of digital platforms.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Animators and Visual Effects Artists, Digital Game Developers, Graphic Designers and Illustrators are excluded from this unit group. Animators and Visual Effects Artists, Graphic Designers and Illustrators are included in Unit Group 2423 Graphic and Visual Content Designers. Digital Game Developers are included in Occupation 273131 Digital Game Developer.

groups.title: Fashion, Industrial, Jewellery and Textile Designers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, design, develop and document products for manufacture and prepare designs and specifications of products for mass, batch and one-off production.

groups.title: Graphic and Visual Content Designers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, design and develop animation, pictures, diagrams, visual effects and other visual content for a variety of purposes.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Digital Game Developers, Multimedia Designers, UI / UX Designers and Web Designers are excluded from this unit group. Digital Game Developers are included in Occupation 273131 Digital Game Developer. Multimedia Designers, UI / UX Designers and Web Designers are included in Unit Group 2421 Digital Designers.

groups.title: Interior Designers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, design, detail and coordinate the construction of commercial, residential, institutional, recreational and temporary interior spaces to transform environments and improve their performance, experience, meaning or purpose.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Interior Decorators are excluded from this unit group. Interior Decorators are included in Occupation 391931 Interior Decorator.

groups.title: Engineering Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Design, plan and organise the testing, construction, installation and maintenance of structures, machines and their components, and production systems and plants, and plan production schedules and work procedures to ensure engineering projects are undertaken efficiently and in a cost effective manner.

groups.title: Chemical and Materials Engineering Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Design and prepare specifications for chemical process systems and the construction and operation of commercial-scale chemical plants, supervise industrial processing and fabrication of products undergoing physical and chemical change, develop and provide advice on processes used to extract metals from their ores, investigate the properties of metals, ceramics, polymers and other materials, and assess and develop their engineering and commercial applications.

groups.title: Civil Engineering Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Design, plan, organise and oversee the construction of civil engineering projects such as dams, bridges, pipelines, gas and water supply schemes, sewerage systems, roads, airports and other structures, analyse the likely behaviour of soil and rock when placed under pressure by proposed structures and design structural foundations, analyse the statical properties of all types of structures and test the behaviour and durability of materials used in their construction, and plan and develop transportation systems.

groups.title: Electrical Engineering Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Design, develop, implement and supervise the manufacture, installation, operation and maintenance of equipment, machines and systems used for the generation, distribution, utilisation and control of electric power, and develop systems used to signal and control trains.

groups.title: Electronics Engineers
groups.leadStatement: Design, develop, adapt, install, test and maintain electronic components, circuits and systems used for computer, communication, command and warfare systems, entertainment, transport and other industrial applications.

groups.title: Industrial, Mechanical and Production Engineers
groups.leadStatement: Design, organise and oversee the construction, operation, logistics and maintenance of mechanical and process plant and installations, establish programs for the coordination of manufacturing activities, and ensure usage of resources is cost effective.

groups.title: Mining Engineers
groups.leadStatement: Plan and direct the engineering aspects of locating and extracting minerals, petroleum and natural gas from the earth.

groups.title: Other Engineering Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Engineering Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Acoustic Engineers, Aerospace Engineers, Biomedical Engineers, Engineering Technologists, Environmental Engineers, Fire Safety Engineers, Mechatronics Engineers and Naval Architects.

groups.title: Natural and Physical Science Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Perform analytical, conceptual and practical tasks in relation to environmental factors and agricultural production, the chemical and physical properties of the universe, the extraction and processing of mineral ores, life forms including the physiology and biochemistry of humans, plants and animals, and disease prevention.

groups.title: Agricultural, Fisheries and Forestry Scientists
groups.leadStatement: Advise farmers, primary industries and government on aspects of farming, fisheries, aquaculture and forestry, develop techniques for increasing productivity, and study and develop plans and policies for the management of land, fisheries and forest areas.

groups.title: Chemists, and Food and Wine Scientists
groups.leadStatement: Study the chemical and physical properties of substances, develop and monitor chemical processes and production, develop new and improve existing food products, and plan and coordinate the production of wine and spirits.

groups.title: Environmental Conservation Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Protect, manage and restore ecosystems and landscapes, and enhance them via appropriate management and conservation, promote public understanding and awareness of the natural environment and help to develop and implement appropriate policies to achieve these objectives.

groups.title: Environmental Consultants and Scientists
groups.leadStatement: Analyse and advise on policies and practices guiding the design, implementation and modification of environmental operations and programs, and study and develop policies and plans for controlling adverse environmental factors and the protection, effective management, restoration and recovery of the environment.

groups.title: Geoscientists and Hydrologists
groups.leadStatement: Study the composition, structure and other physical attributes of the Earth and other planetary bodies to increase scientific knowledge and to locate, model and advise on planetary processes and the extraction of minerals, petroleum and ground and surface water.

groups.title: Life Scientists
groups.leadStatement: Study the anatomy, physiology, characteristics and behaviour of animals, plants, insects and other living organisms to better understand how living organisms function and interact with each other and the environment in which they live, and to develop and improve biotechnological products and processes.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Ecologists are excluded from this unit group. Ecologists are included in Occupation 244333 Ecologist.

groups.title: Medical Science Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Research and advise on the safe and effective delivery of radiation as prescribed in patient care, and perform, validate and interpret the results of medical laboratory tests used in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of human diseases.

groups.title: Other Natural and Physical Science Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Natural and Physical Science Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Conservators, Meteorologists and Physicists.

groups.title: Education Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Teach in educational institutions or through private tuition, conduct educational research, develop course curricula and associated teaching materials, and review and examine the work of teachers.

groups.title: Early Childhood, School and Specialist Education Teachers
groups.leadStatement: Teach students in early childhood (pre-primary), primary and secondary institutions by teaching a range of subjects within a prescribed curriculum, and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.

groups.title: Early Childhood (Pre-primary School) Teachers
groups.leadStatement: Design, plan, teach and evaluate educational programs and practices for young children, including following and implementing an approved learning framework in an early childhood setting.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Early Childhood Educators and Room Leaders, preschool directors and Special Education Teachers are excluded from this unit group. Early Childhood Educators and Room Leaders are included in Unit Group 4311 Early Childhood Educators and Room Leaders. Preschool directors are included in Occupation 141231 Children's Education and Care Service Director. Special Education Teachers are included in Occupation 251431 Special Education Teachers.

groups.title: Primary School Teachers
groups.leadStatement: Teach a range of subjects within a prescribed curriculum to primary school students and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Special Education Teachers are excluded from this unit group. Special Education Teachers are included in Occupation 251431 Special Education Teacher.

groups.title: Secondary School Teachers
groups.leadStatement: Teach one or more subjects within a prescribed curriculum to secondary school students and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Special Education Teachers are excluded from this unit group. Special Education Teachers are included in Occupation 251431 Special Education Teacher.

groups.title: Specialist Education Teachers
groups.leadStatement: Teach academic and living skills to children and adults with learning difficulties, who are blind or have low vision, or are deaf or hard of hearing, and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Social educators are excluded from this unit group. Social educators are included in Occupation 422231 Disability Support Worker.

groups.title: Other Early Childhood, School and Specialist Education Teachers
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Early Childhood, School and Specialist Education Teachers not elsewhere classified. It includes Teacher Librarians.

groups.title: Tertiary Educators
groups.leadStatement: Educate tertiary students in one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at universities, TAFE institutes, RTOs and other vocational training institutes, and teach adult and community education courses.

groups.title: University Lecturers and Tutors
groups.leadStatement: Prepare and deliver lectures and conduct tutorials in one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at a university and conduct research in a particular field of knowledge.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Private Tutors are excluded from this unit group. Private Tutors are included in Minor Group 259 Miscellaneous Education Professionals.

groups.title: Vocational Education Teachers
groups.leadStatement: Teach one or more vocational subjects within a prescribed course of study to students at TAFE institutes, RTOs or other training institutes for vocational education and training purposes.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Adult Literacy / Numeracy Teachers and Workplace Trainers and Assessors are excluded from this occupation. Adult Literacy / Numeracy Teachers are included in Occupation 259931 Adult Literacy / Numeracy Teacher. Workplace Trainers and Assessors are included in Occupation 222431 Training and Development Professional

groups.title: Miscellaneous Education Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This minor group covers Education Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Academic Tutors (Private Tuition), Arts and Personal Enrichment Teachers (Private Tuition), Education Advisers and Reviewers, Music Teachers (Private Tuition) and Teachers of English to Speakers of Other Languages.

groups.title: Academic Tutors (Private Tuition)
groups.leadStatement: Provide tuition to students in academic subjects and prepare students for formal assessment tasks.
groups.inclusionExclusion: University Tutors are excluded from this unit group. University Tutors are included in Occupation 252132 University Tutor.

groups.title: Arts and Personal Enrichment Teachers (Private Tuition)
groups.leadStatement: Teach students in the practice, theory and performance of art, dance, speech and drama in private training establishments.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Music Tutors are excluded from this unit group. Music Tutors are included in Occupation 259431 Music Teacher (Private Tuition).

groups.title: Education Advisers and Reviewers
groups.leadStatement: Enhance quality of education by providing support and guidance to educational institutes, teachers and students, and review and examine the work of teachers and the results from curriculum programs in school settings.

groups.title: Music Teachers (Private Tuition)
groups.leadStatement: Teach students in the practice, theory and performance of music in private training establishments.

groups.title: Teachers of English to Speakers of Other Languages
groups.leadStatement: Teach English to students whose first language is a language other than English.

groups.title: Other Education Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Education Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Adult Literacy / Numeracy Teachers, Careers Advisers and Student Services Advisers.

groups.title: Health Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Assess, diagnose and treat physical, physiological and psychological disorders, and provide nursing care and counselling services to maintain, promote and restore emotional, social and mental health and wellbeing.

groups.title: Allied Health Counselling, Psychology, Social Work and Creative Therapy Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Provide assessment, counselling, biopsychosocial interventions, support and other services as authorised in their scope of practice, to promote optimal personal, social, vocational and educational health and wellbeing, and undertake research and advocacy roles.

groups.title: Counsellors and Psychotherapists
groups.leadStatement: Provide counselling services to assist individuals to identify, define and overcome their relationship, addiction, mental health, social and health issues through a range of therapeutic interventions.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Psychologists are excluded from this unit group. Psychologists are included in Occupation 261231 Psychologist.

groups.title: Psychologists
groups.leadStatement: Provide individuals and groups with evidence-based assessment, prevention, intervention and treatment to foster personal, social, educational and occupational wellbeing and development.

groups.title: Social Workers
groups.leadStatement: Assess the biopsychosocial needs of individuals, families and groups, assist and empower people to develop and use skills and resources needed to resolve social and other problems, and further human wellbeing and human rights, social justice and social development.

groups.title: Other Allied Health Counselling, Psychology, Social Work and Creative Therapy Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Allied Health Counselling, Psychology, Social Work and Creative Therapy Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Arts Therapists, Behaviour Support Practitioners and Music Therapists.

groups.title: Allied Health Physical and Sensory Therapy Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Assess, diagnose (as authorised in their scopes of practice) and treat illnesses and disabilities, and provide evidence-based therapeutic services such as chiropractic, exercise physiology, occupational therapy, osteopathy, physiotherapy, podiatry and speech pathology.

groups.title: Chiropractors
groups.leadStatement: Diagnose, manage and prevent mechanical disorders of the neuromusculoskeletal system, and the effects these disorders have on the function of the nervous system and general health.

groups.title: Exercise Physiologists and Scientists
groups.leadStatement: Assess, plan, implement and design exercise-based interventions to improve health, fitness and wellbeing and to prevent, treat and manage disease and injury and restore optimal physical function and wellness.

groups.title: Occupational Therapists
groups.leadStatement: Assess functional limitations of people resulting from injuries, illnesses and disabilities and provide therapy to enable people to perform their daily activities and occupations.

groups.title: Physiotherapists
groups.leadStatement: Assess, diagnose, treat and prevent disorders in human movement caused by injury or disease.

groups.title: Podiatrists
groups.leadStatement: Prevent, diagnose and treat disorders that affect feet, ankles and lower limbs.

groups.title: Speech Pathologists
groups.leadStatement: Provides diagnostic assessment and management of disorders of communication and swallowing through direct intervention, education, consultancy, advocacy, or a combination of these approaches across the lifespan.

groups.title: Other Allied Health Physical and Sensory Therapy Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Allied Health Physical and Sensory Therapy Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Orthotists / Prosthetists, and Osteopaths.

groups.title: Allied Health Science Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Conduct and utilise diagnostic tests and operate equipment to assess and treat illnesses and disabilities, provide health and nutritional therapy and advice, dispense and administer pharmaceuticals, and detect, manage and treat hearing and vision problems and diseases.

groups.title: Medical Radiation Practitioners
groups.leadStatement: Operate X-ray and other radiation producing and imaging equipment for diagnostic, monitoring and treatment purposes under the direction of Radiologists and other Medical Practitioners.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Sonographers are excluded from this unit group. Sonographers are included in Occupation 263531 Sonographer.

groups.title: Nutrition Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Apply the science of food and human nutrition to enhance the health and wellbeing of individuals and human populations, and to help prevent and treat various illnesses and diseases.

groups.title: Optometrists
groups.leadStatement: Perform eye examinations and vision tests to determine the presence of visual, ocular and other abnormalities, ocular diseases and systemic diseases with ocular manifestations, and prescribe lenses, other optical aids, therapy and medication to correct and manage vision problems and eye diseases.

groups.title: Pharmacists
groups.leadStatement: Apply in-depth knowledge of medicines and medication management to ensure the safe use of medicines, and optimise health outcomes by contributing to prescribing, dispensing, administering, monitoring and evaluating medicine therapy.

groups.title: Sonographers
groups.leadStatement: Examine patients and operate ultrasound equipment to acquire, interpret and selectively record anatomical images, physical data and real-time physiological information.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Cardiac technicians are excluded from this unit group. Cardiac technicians are included in Occupation 263932 Cardiac Physiologist.

groups.title: Other Allied Health Science Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Allied Health Science Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Audiologists, Cardiac Physiologists, Diabetes Educators, Neurophysiology Scientists, Orthoptists and Respiratory and Sleep Scientists.

groups.title: Medical Practitioners
groups.leadStatement: Diagnose physical and mental illnesses, disorders and injuries, provide medical care to patients, and prescribe and perform medical and surgical treatments to promote and restore good health.

groups.title: Anaesthetists
groups.leadStatement: Provide direct medical care to patients requiring general, regional or local anaesthesia for surgical, diagnostic and other procedures such as prevention of pain and maintenance of body function.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Anaesthetic registrars training as Anaesthetists are included in this unit group.

groups.title: General Practitioners
groups.leadStatement: Diagnose, treat and prevent human physical and mental disorders and injuries.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Resident Medical Officers are excluded from this unit group. Resident Medical Officers are included in Occupation 264531 Resident Medical Officer.

groups.title: Physicians
groups.leadStatement: Investigate, diagnose and treat complex medical conditions chiefly concerning internal human disorders and diseases using specialist testing, diagnostic and medical techniques, and provide medical input into managing public health issues and infectious disease outbreaks and control measures.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Medical registrars training as Physicians are included in this unit group.

groups.title: Psychiatrists
groups.leadStatement: Diagnose, assess, treat and prevent mental, emotional and behavioural conditions.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Psychiatric registrars training as Psychiatrists are included in this unit group.

groups.title: Resident Medical Officers
groups.leadStatement: Diagnose, treat and prevent human physical and mental disorders and injuries under the supervision of senior Medical Practitioners.

groups.title: Surgeons
groups.leadStatement: Perform surgery to treat and prevent diseases and illnesses, correct deformities, repair injuries, and improve human functioning and appearance.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Medical registrars training as Surgeons are included in this unit group.; Oral and maxillofacial surgeons and podiatric surgeons are excluded from this unit group. Oral and maxillofacial surgeons are included in Occupation 269231 Dental Specialist. Podiatric surgeons are included in Occupation 262531 Podiatrist.

groups.title: Other Medical Practitioners
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Medical Practitioners not elsewhere classified. It includes Dermatologists, Emergency Medicine Specialists, Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, Ophthalmologists, Pathologists, Radiation Oncologists and Radiologists.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Medical registrars training in these specialties are included in this unit group.

groups.title: Midwifery and Nursing Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Provide care to mothers and their babies, people in aged care, community, welfare, hospitals, and other health care settings, provide clinical education to midwives and nurses, conduct research into clinical nursing practice, and manage health service units and sub-units that provide nursing and midwifery care.

groups.title: Midwives
groups.leadStatement: Provide care and advice to women during pregnancy, labour and childbirth, and postnatal care for women and babies in a range of settings such as the home, community, hospitals, clinics and health units.

groups.title: Nurse Educators and Researchers
groups.leadStatement: Provide clinical and theoretical education to nurses and Midwives, promote professional development, and conduct research into nursing practices.

groups.title: Nursing and Midwifery Unit Managers
groups.leadStatement: Manage health service units and sub-units of hospitals and community health care facilities to enable the provision of safe, cost-effective nursing and midwifery care.

groups.title: Registered Nurses
groups.leadStatement: Provide nursing care to people in aged care, community, welfare, hospital and other health care settings.

groups.title: Miscellaneous Health Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This minor group covers Health Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Dental Hygienists, Prosthetists and Therapists, Dentists and Dental Specialists, Environmental Health and Health Promotion Officers, Paramedic Professionals, and Veterinarians and Veterinary Technologists.

groups.title: Dental Hygienists, Prosthetists and Therapists
groups.leadStatement: Assess, diagnose, treat and manage patients with oral health disease and removable dental prostheses, prevent oral disease and promote healthy oral behaviours.

groups.title: Dentists and Dental Specialists
groups.leadStatement: Diagnose and treat dental disease, restore normal oral function using a broad range of treatments such as surgery and other specialist techniques, and advise on oral health.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Oral and maxillofacial surgeons are included in this unit group.

groups.title: Environmental Health and Health Promotion Officers
groups.leadStatement: Develop, enforce and evaluate environmental health policies, programs and strategies, and assist health and community groups to improve the health of individuals and the community.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Policy Analysts are excluded from this unit group. Policy Analysts are included in Occupation 223332 Policy Analyst.

groups.title: Paramedic Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Assess, diagnose, treat and provide specialised health care and life support treatments for patients in a range of settings including medical emergencies and situations requiring critical care and extended care in an out-of-hospital environment.

groups.title: Veterinarians and Veterinary Technologists
groups.leadStatement: Carry out diagnostic procedures used in the medical care of animals, and diagnose, treat and prevent animal diseases, ailments and injuries.

groups.title: Other Health Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Health Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Acupuncturists, Chinese Medicine Practitioners and Naturopaths.

groups.title: ICT Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Perform analytical, conceptual and practical tasks that support the efficient and secure provision of ICT services to government, commercial and industrial organisations, and individuals.

groups.title: Cyber Security Professionals and Database and Systems Administrators
groups.leadStatement: Design, develop, install, test and maintain cyber security and database standards, guidelines, software and systems.

groups.title: Cyber Security Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Develop and implement cyber security standards and guidelines, develop and install cyber security software and systems, conduct risk and security control assessments, analyse and address vulnerabilities in digital infrastructure, and respond to cyber security incidents.

groups.title: Database and Systems Administrators
groups.leadStatement: Design, develop, install and maintain operating systems, software and server hardware to support secure and reliable database management systems.

groups.title: ICT Network and Testing Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Research, analyse, plan, design, install, monitor, test and maintain ICT and telecommunications systems and networks to support the needs of organisations and individuals.

groups.title: ICT Network Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Analyse and recommend strategies for network architecture and development, implement, manage, maintain and configure network hardware and software, monitor and optimise network performance, and troubleshoot and provide user support.

groups.title: ICT Quality Engineers and Test Analysts
groups.leadStatement: Develop procedures and strategies to support, create, maintain and manage technical quality assurance processes, guidelines and systems infrastructure, investigate, analyse and resolve system problems and performance issues, and test the behaviour, functionality and integrity of systems.

groups.title: Telecommunications Engineers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, design, develop and monitor telecommunication systems, networks, devices and broadcasting equipment.

groups.title: ICT Programmers, Analysts, Architects and Engineers
groups.leadStatement: Design, develop and maintain digital games, websites, ICT systems, cloud infrastructure and software applications, review and modify processes and methods, and communicate with users to ensure their needs are met.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Cyber Security Architects, Cyber Security Engineers, Data Architects and Data Engineers are excluded from this minor group. Cyber Security Architects and Cyber Security Engineers are included in Unit Group 2711 Cyber Security Professionals. Data Architects and Data Engineers are included in Unit Group 2232 Data Professionals.

groups.title: Digital Game and Web Developers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, develop, transform and maintain digital games and websites.

groups.title: ICT Business and Systems Analysts and Architects
groups.leadStatement: Design, develop, manage and evaluate ICT systems and software solutions, processes, methods and cloud infrastructure, and communicate with users to ensure outcomes meet their needs.

groups.title: Software and Applications Engineers
groups.leadStatement: Design, build and maintain software applications and cloud-based services, and facilitate collaboration and integration across different specialist ICT teams.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Cyber Security Engineers and Digital Game Developers are excluded from this unit group. Cyber Security Engineers are included in Occupation 271135 Cyber Security Engineer. Digital Game Developers are included in Occupation 273131 Digital Game Developer.

groups.title: Legal Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Provide legal advice, prepare and draft legal documents, conduct negotiations on behalf of clients, plead cases in courts and tribunals, hear legal and other matters in courts and tribunals, and interpret, analyse, administer and review the law.

groups.title: Legal Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Provide legal advice, prepare and draft legal documents, conduct negotiations on behalf of clients, plead cases in courts and tribunals, hear legal and other matters in courts and tribunals, and interpret, analyse, administer and review the law.

groups.title: Barristers
groups.leadStatement: Plead cases before civil, criminal and industrial courts and other tribunals.

groups.title: Judicial and Other Legal Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Hear legal and other matters in courts and tribunals, interpret, analyse, administer and provide advice on family, intellectual property and migration law, and represent the state in the lower courts.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Solicitors are excluded from this unit group. Solicitors are included in Occupation 281331 Solicitor.

groups.title: Solicitors
groups.leadStatement: Provide legal advice, prepare legal documents, conduct negotiations on behalf of clients on matters associated with the law, and plead cases before civil, criminal and industrial courts and tribunals.

groups.title: Other Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This sub-major group covers Professionals not elsewhere classified.

groups.title: Miscellaneous Professionals
groups.leadStatement: This minor group covers Professionals not elsewhere classified. It includes Air Transport Professionals and Specialist Police Officers.

groups.title: Air Transport Professionals
groups.leadStatement: Fly and navigate aircraft, control air traffic to ensure the safe and efficient operation of aircraft in flight and on the ground, and instruct students in flying aircraft.

groups.title: Specialist Police Officers
groups.leadStatement: Use specialised operational tactics and technology to undertake serious crimes investigations, analyse evidence, resolve high-risk situations and run specialist police operations.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Police Prosecutors are excluded from this unit group. Police Prosecutors are included in Occupation 281237 Police Prosecutor.

groups.title: Technicians and Trades Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of skilled tasks, applying broad or in-depth technical, trade or industry specific knowledge, often in support of scientific, engineering, building and manufacturing activities.

groups.title: Building, Engineering, ICT and Scientific Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Perform tests and experiments, and provide technical support to Managers and Professionals engaged in research, design and development in the areas of agriculture, medicine, science, building, engineering, ICT and telecommunications.

groups.title: Agricultural, Health and Science Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Perform tests and experiments including inspecting animals, plants and agricultural produce, and provide support to Managers and Professionals engaged in agriculture, health and science.

groups.title: Agricultural Technicians and Inspection Officers
groups.leadStatement: Provide technical support to Managers and Professionals engaged in agriculture, and perform tests and experiments including inspecting animals, plants and agricultural produce and facilities, to ensure compliance with government and industry standards.

groups.title: Medical and Dental Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Operate anaesthetic, operating theatre and medical testing equipment, construct and repair dentures and other dental appliances, and perform and assist with laboratory tests in support of Health Professionals.

groups.title: Pharmacy Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Dispense and label patients' prescriptions, manage scheduled medicines, and provide clinical assistance under the supervision of Community and Hospital Pharmacists.

groups.title: Phlebotomists
groups.leadStatement: Extract, collect, label and preserve blood and other specimens from patients for laboratory analysis.

groups.title: Science Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Perform tests and experiments, and provide technical support functions to assist with research, design, production and teaching in the natural sciences.

groups.title: Building and Construction Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Provide technical support to construction managers, Architects and building professionals by coordinating building designs, inspecting buildings and equipment, estimating construction costs and supervising construction sites.

groups.title: Building and Landscape Designers and Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Create and coordinate building and landscape designs, produce detailed plans based off architectural drawings, monitor the technical progress of architectural projects, and collect and analyse survey data, in consultation with Architects, Planners and Surveyors, and builders.

groups.title: Construction and Safety Inspectors
groups.leadStatement: Inspect and report on the quality and safety of buildings, plumbing work, machines, equipment, working conditions and public places to ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations.

groups.title: Construction Estimators
groups.leadStatement: Prepare and deliver estimates and cost plans for construction projects up to tender settlement stage.

groups.title: Construction Supervisors
groups.leadStatement: Organise the daily operations of construction sites and supervise and perform specialist roles in small civil work teams.

groups.title: Engineering Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Provide technical support to Engineering Professionals in the design, operation, installation and maintenance of engineering equipment and systems.

groups.title: Civil Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Assist in civil engineering research, design, construction, operations and maintenance.

groups.title: Electrical Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Support and assist Engineering Professionals in the design, testing, analysis and assembly of electrical systems.

groups.title: Maintenance Planners
groups.leadStatement: Develop maintenance planning strategies for, and schedule, coordinate and monitor the maintenance of, plant equipment, infrastructure and machinery.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Facilities Managers are excluded from this unit group. Facilities Managers are included in Occupation 172331 Facilities Manager.

groups.title: Marine Transport Masters, Officers and Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Control and manage the operation and maintenance of marine vessels and equipment.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Marine Technicians who repair and maintain inboard and outboard marine motors are excluded from this unit group. Marine Technicians are included in Occupation 351435 Marine Technician.

groups.title: Mining Supervisors
groups.leadStatement: Oversee the safety of mining operations and supervise Miners.

groups.title: Other Engineering Technicians
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Engineering Technicians not elsewhere classified. It includes Biomedical Technicians, Electronic Engineering Technicians, Mechanical Engineering Draftspersons, Mechanical Engineering Technicians, Metallurgical and Materials Technicians, Non-destructive Testing Technicians and Other Draftspersons.

groups.title: ICT and Telecommunications Technicians and Support Officers
groups.leadStatement: Provide support for the development and maintenance of computer infrastructure, software and telecommunications networks, including the diagnosis and resolution of technical problems.

groups.title: ICT and Telecommunications Technicians
groups.leadStatement: Monitor and provide technical support functions for ICT and telecommunications networks and infrastructure, including the diagnosis and resolution of technical problems.
groups.inclusionExclusion: ICT Customer Support Officers are excluded from this unit group. ICT Customer Support Officers are included in Occupation 314231 ICT Customer Support Officer.

groups.title: ICT Customer Support Officers
groups.leadStatement: Provide support, education and guidance in the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure and software, and the diagnosis and resolution of technical problems and issues.

groups.title: Chefs and Food Trades Workers
groups.leadStatement: Plan, organise, prepare and cook food for dining and catering establishments, bake bread and pastry goods, and prepare meat for sale.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Senior Chefs are excluded from this sub-major group. Senior Chefs are included in Occupation 161631 Senior Chef.

groups.title: Chefs
groups.leadStatement: Plan and organise the preparation and cooking of food in dining and catering establishments.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Senior Chefs are excluded from this minor group. Senior Chefs are included in Occupation 161631 Senior Chef.

groups.title: Chefs
groups.leadStatement: Plan and organise the preparation and cooking of food in dining and catering establishments.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Senior Chefs are excluded from this unit group. Senior Chefs are included in Occupation 161631 Senior Chef.

groups.title: Food Trades Workers
groups.leadStatement: Bake bread and pastry goods, prepare meat for sale, and prepare and cook food for dining and catering establishments.

groups.title: Bakers
groups.leadStatement: Prepare and bake bread loaves, rolls, biscuits and other baked goods.

groups.title: Butchers and Smallgoods Makers
groups.leadStatement: Select, cut, trim, prepare and arrange meat for sale and supply, operate meat and smallgoods processing machines, and manage the processes in the production of smallgoods.

groups.title: Cooks
groups.leadStatement: Prepare, season and cook food in dining and catering establishments.

groups.title: Drycleaners and Laundry Workers
groups.leadStatement: Sort, clean, fold, iron and package linen, clothing and other items in laundries and drycleaning establishments, and private residences.

groups.title: Housekeepers
groups.leadStatement: Perform cleaning and housekeeping duties in hotels, motels and other commercial premises, and in private residences.

groups.title: Vehicle Detailers
groups.leadStatement: Wash and clean exteriors and interiors of vehicles, and touch up paint work, glass and upholstery to prepare them for private and commercial usage, sale and rent.

groups.title: Other Cleaners and Laundry Workers
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Cleaners and Laundry Workers not elsewhere classified. It includes Carpet Cleaners, Roof Gutter Cleaners and Window Cleaners.

groups.title: Construction and Mining Labourers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of routine tasks in house building, road, rail and general construction, and in drilling, mining and mineral ore treatment, usually under supervision.

groups.title: Construction and Mining Labourers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of routine tasks in house building, road, rail and general construction, and in drilling, mining and mineral ore treatment, usually under supervision.

groups.title: Construction and Demolition Labourers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of routine tasks associated with preparing, erecting and repairing structures and facilities, excavating earth and clearing and levelling sites, demolishing and dismantling buildings and structures, and removing and disposing of asbestos.

groups.title: Construction Riggers and Doggers
groups.leadStatement: Sling cranes and winches, assemble and install rigging gear, and direct the movement of loads while ensuring that they do not exceed lifting capacities.

groups.title: Fencers
groups.leadStatement: Erect and repair fences and gates.

groups.title: Home Improvement and Insulation Installers
groups.leadStatement: Install functional and decorative home improvements including garage doors, sheds, window furnishings and building insulation materials.

groups.title: Paving and Surfacing Labourers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks associated with laying bituminous and other paving materials on roads, runways, parking areas and other surfaces to be paved.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Concreter's Labourers are excluded from this unit group. Concreter's Labourers are included in Occupation 821133 Concreter's Labourer.

groups.title: Plumbing and Drainage Labourers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in laying, assembling and connecting pipe systems, fixtures, water meters and regulators, and in maintaining drainage, sewerage and stormwater systems.

groups.title: Structural Steel Construction Workers
groups.leadStatement: Erect and dismantle scaffolding and structural steel frames, and position steel in concrete forms to reinforce concrete structures.

groups.title: Other Construction and Mining Labourers
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Construction and Mining Labourers not elsewhere classified. It includes Driller's Offsiders, Laggers, Mining Support Workers, Rail Protection Officers, Railway Track Workers and Surveyor's Assistants.

groups.title: Factory Process Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in processing, manufacturing and packaging food, beverages and other products.

groups.title: Food Process Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in processing and manufacturing food and beverages.

groups.title: Food and Drink Factory Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in manufacturing food and beverages.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Packers are excluded from this unit group. Packers are included in Unit Group 8321 Packers.

groups.title: Meat Boners and Slicers, and Slaughterers
groups.leadStatement: Slaughter livestock, prepare carcasses for further processing, and trim and cut meat from bones, sides and carcasses.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Poultry slaughterers are excluded from this unit group. Poultry slaughterers are included in Occupation 831332 Poultry Process Worker.

groups.title: Meat, Poultry and Seafood Process Workers
groups.leadStatement: Slaughter and eviscerate poultry, and process, grade and package meat, poultry, fish and shellfish.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Meat Boners and Slicers and Meat Packers are excluded from this unit group. Meat Boners and Slicers are included in Occupation 831231 Meat Boner and Slicer. Meat Packers are included in Occupation 832134 Meat Packer.

groups.title: Packers and Product Assemblers
groups.leadStatement: Wrap and place items into containers, seal containers in preparation for dispatch to customers, and assemble components and subassemblies of products.

groups.title: Packers
groups.leadStatement: Weigh, wrap, seal and label chocolate, fruit, vegetables, meat, seafood and other products.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Poultry packers are excluded from this unit group. Poultry packers are included in Occupation 831332 Poultry Process Worker.

groups.title: Product Assemblers
groups.leadStatement: Put together components and subassemblies that go into the mass production of jewellery and precious metal articles, joinery products, metal products, electrical and electronic equipment, automotive components, and other goods in factories and production lines.

groups.title: Miscellaneous Factory Process Workers
groups.leadStatement: This minor group covers Factory Process Workers not elsewhere classified. It includes Materials and Chemical Process Workers and Product Quality Controllers.

groups.title: Materials and Chemical Process Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in assembling and manufacturing materials including cement, concrete, chemicals, fabric, textiles, glass, metals, paper, pulp, plastics, timber and wood, and sorting and processing recycled materials.

groups.title: Product Quality Controllers
groups.leadStatement: Examine, evaluate and test manufactured products and primary produce to ensure conformity to specifications and standards of presentation and quality.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Primary Products Quality Assurance Officers are excluded from this unit group. Primary Products Quality Assurance Officers are included in Occupation 311138 Primary Products Quality Assurance Officer.

groups.title: Farm, Garden and Forestry Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of routine tasks in cultivating and harvesting crops, plants and forests, and breeding, feeding and raising livestock and aquatic stock to support the production of breeding stock, meat, milk, eggs, honey, wool, wood, crops and plants.

groups.title: Farm Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of routine tasks in cultivating and harvesting crops and feeding and raising livestock and aquatic stock to support the production of breeding stock, meat, milk, eggs, wool, honey and crops.

groups.title: Crop Farm Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in producing crops such as cereals, cotton, fruit (including wine grapes), grains, mushrooms, nuts, oilseeds, pulses, rice, sugar cane and vegetables.

groups.title: Livestock Farm Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in livestock, meat, milk, egg, honey and wool production.

groups.title: Mixed Production and Aquaculture Farm Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform routine tasks in support of aquaculture farming operations and farming operations spanning two or more of the four different primary production areas - broadacre crops, horticultural crops, livestock and aquaculture.

groups.title: Garden and Forestry Workers
groups.leadStatement: Perform a variety of routine tasks in propagating and cultivating plants, planting and maintaining gardens, assisting with the management of forests, including conservation, and assisting with installing, servicing and maintaining irrigation systems.

groups.title: Garden Labourers
groups.leadStatement: Assist in cultivating and maintaining gardens.

groups.title: Horticultural Nursery Assistants
groups.leadStatement: Assist in propagating, cultivating and harvesting plants in a horticultural nursery. May also assist in propagating and cultivating plants for forestry purposes.

groups.title: Other Garden and Forestry Workers
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Garden and Forestry Workers not elsewhere classified. It includes Bush Regenerators, Forestry Workers and Irrigation Assistants.

groups.title: Fast Food Cooks and Food Preparation Assistants
groups.leadStatement: Prepare food in fast food establishments, assist kitchen and service staff to prepare and serve food, and clean food preparation equipment and service areas.

groups.title: Fast Food Cooks and Food Preparation Assistants
groups.leadStatement: Prepare food in fast food establishments, assist kitchen and service staff to prepare and serve food, and clean food preparation equipment and service areas.

groups.title: Fast Food Cooks
groups.leadStatement: Prepare and cook a restricted range of foods in fast food establishments.

groups.title: Food Preparation Assistants
groups.leadStatement: Assist kitchen and service staff to prepare and serve food, and clean food preparation equipment and service areas.

groups.title: Other Labourers
groups.leadStatement: This sub-major group covers Labourers not elsewhere classified. It includes Freight Handlers and Shelf Fillers.

groups.title: Freight Handlers and Shelf Fillers
groups.leadStatement: Load and unload trucks, containers and rail cars and fill up shelves and display areas in stores and supermarkets.

groups.title: Freight and Furniture Handlers
groups.leadStatement: Load and unload trucks, containers and rail cars.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Forklift Drivers are excluded from this unit group. Forklift Drivers are included in Occupation 741331 Forklift Driver.

groups.title: Shelf Fillers
groups.leadStatement: Fill up shelves and display areas in stores and supermarkets.

groups.title: Miscellaneous Labourers
groups.leadStatement: This minor group covers Labourers not elsewhere classified. It includes Caretakers, Deck and Fishing Hands, Handypersons, Motor Vehicle Parts and Accessories Fitters, Rail Guards, Conductors and Railways Assistants, and Road Traffic Controllers.

groups.title: Caretakers
groups.leadStatement: Maintain and clean residential buildings, schools, offices, holiday camps, caravan parks and associated grounds.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Handypersons are excluded from this unit group. Handypersons are included in Occupation 899331 Handyperson.

groups.title: Deck and Fishing Hands
groups.leadStatement: Perform a range of maintenance and lookout tasks and operate deck equipment aboard marine vessels, and catch fish, crustacea and molluscs in ocean and inland waters.

groups.title: Handypersons
groups.leadStatement: Clean, paint, repair and maintain buildings, grounds and facilities.
groups.inclusionExclusion: Caretakers are excluded from this unit group. Caretakers are included in Occupation 899131 Caretaker.

groups.title: Motor Vehicle Parts and Accessories Fitters
groups.leadStatement: Fit, repair and replace tyres, windscreens and other parts and accessories on motor vehicles, re-assemble mechanical components, change oil and filters, and perform other routine mechanical tasks.

groups.title: Rail Guards, Conductors and Railways Assistants
groups.leadStatement: Maintain passenger safety on trains and in railway stations, sell and check passenger tickets for train travel, and assist with operating and maintaining facilities at railway stations.

groups.title: Road Traffic Controllers
groups.leadStatement: Direct road traffic and pedestrian flows on, near and adjacent to roads during road closures and part road closures due to construction, maintenance, roadside works, public events and emergency responses.

groups.title: Other Miscellaneous Labourers
groups.leadStatement: This unit group covers Labourers not elsewhere classified. It includes Car Park Attendants, Crossing Supervisors, Electrical and Telecommunications Trades Assistants, Leaflet and Newspaper Deliverers, Recycling and Waste Collectors, Sign Installers, Swimming Pool and Spa Technicians, Trolley Collectors and Vending Machine Attendants.
